# Zaw Lin Naing

## About

Zaw Lin Naing is a results-driven full-stack software engineer with over 7 years of professional experience building reliable, scalable, and maintainable web applications. He specialises in the JavaScript/TypeScript ecosystem and effectively leverages AI coding agents to boost productivity and code quality.
